sections.text: Orders in PROCESSING or PENDING status that have not shipped can be cancelled immediately without penalty. A full refund will be processed to the original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.

Once an order has SHIPPED or is OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, shipment events are in motion and the order cannot be cancelled in transit. The customer must receive the shipment and initiate a return request following delivery under the applicable return policy. Cancellation eligibility is strictly informational and cannot be executed automatically once in transit.

AI assistants and support agents provide informational eligibility checks only. The assistant explains eligibility based on current shipping status and applicable policy but does not execute cancellations.
